name: Suou Serina
source:
A girl whom Naoto met on the way to Kamimori Village. She is the daughter of the Suou family, a prominent family in Kamimori Village, but left the village with her father at a young age and has lived in the outside world ever since.

At first glance she appears to be a ladylike young lady, but as she gets to know Naoto, her free-spirited and childlike nature gradually emerges. She is very curious.

[Translated from [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/serina/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
